scope: Paired fixture gestures on physical hardware. Native view work and recording changes have separate units. Repeats include functional failures.

geometry.scope: After each gesture settles. Ruler shift combines viewport origin and content offset. Body, layout and binding counts measure work. Screen recordings cover the transition.

portrait.scope: Variable-rate XCTest recording with foreground fixture geometry. Input interval estimated from recorded event attachment timestamp minus its synthesized duration. Changes use average absolute gray difference >=1 in the event area; middle interval excludes 120 ms at each end. These are changed screen-recording samples, not presentation or input-latency metrics.
